name: Ultegra R8170 / Dura-Ace R9270 Di2
use_case: Premium road 2x12 electronic shifting with hydraulic-disc or generation-specific wired rim-brake controls
positioning: Premium road benchmarks with lower component weight and additional control features, but no cassette-range advantage over 105 R7170.
architecture: Semi-wireless in the hydraulic-disc builds: wireless levers with front and rear derailleurs connected to one internal BT-DN300 battery; current rim-brake controls are wired.

weight.note: No package-independent total is used; quoted totals must identify whether crank, cassette, chain, calipers, rotors and bottom bracket are included.

battery: Internal BT-DN300 derailleur battery; hydraulic wireless levers use coin cells.
controls_and_app: E-TUBE PROJECT Cyclist supports firmware, adjustment and control configuration; these tiers add control and component refinements rather than cassette range.
package_summary: The dated R8170 ¥6,050 observation was described as a large package including rotors; a separate ¥5,000 observation covers electronic parts plus calipers. Neither is a normalized checkout package.

compatibility.frame: Internal BT-DN300 space and SD300 wire routes to both derailleurs; rim-brake controls require their generation-specific wiring
compatibility.brake_fluid: Shimano mineral oil for hydraulic-disc builds

china_price_status: Secondary dealer-market synthesis: R8170 ¥6,050 large package reportedly including rotors; exact checkout, invoice, warranty and complete contents remain unverified. R9270 price is unverified.

price_observations.conditions: R8170 large package, reported with rotors; underlying dealer checkout was not captured.
R8170 electronic parts plus calipers; not a normalized full groupset.

caveats: Both rear derailleurs stop at 34T; 105 R7170 supports 36T.
Confirm hydraulic-disc versus wired rim-brake controls and every included part.
Treat the observed R8170 premium as a planning lead, not a guaranteed Taobao checkout difference.
